objective: Customize this copied neutral frame for the real target repository without importing assumptions from another application.
invariants: Inspect target evidence before proposing target-specific levels.
Prefer existing public target validators over duplicated checks.
Do not assume a web UI, API, service, database, package manager, language, test framework, or release model.
Keep target mutation disabled by default.
Use stable finding IDs and bounded evidence.
Do not accept required SKIP/BLOCKED/PARTIAL as PASS.
Add dependencies only when a level truly cannot produce useful evidence without them.
Remove or merge levels when the target model is simpler; numbering symmetry is not a goal.
